lines.text: Fig. 2 | Pharmacological characterization of compounds ISM061-018-2 and
ISM061-022 through SPR and cellular activity assays. a,e, Chemical structures
of ISM061-018-2 (a) and ISM061-022 (e). b, SPR sensorgrams illustrating binding
effects of ISM061-018-2 on KRAS protein. c,f, MaMTH-DS dose–response curves
illustrate the binding kinetics and effects of ISM061-018-2 (c) and ISM061-022
(f) on various KRAS proteins, as well as NRAS, HRAS and artificial bait, with
activities measured across concentrations from 4 nM to 30 μM. Data points are
presented as averages from n = 4 technical replicates with error bars showing the
s.d. Each graph is representative of n = 3 biological replicates, performed
under the same conditions. Analyses were carried out using GraphPad Prism.
d,g, Results from CellTiter-Glo viability assays measuring the impact of ISM061-
018-2 (d) and ISM061-022 (g) on cellular proliferation over a concentration
range from 123 nM to 30 μM, demonstrating that they do not display general,
nonspecific toxicity. Data points are presented as averages from n = 3 technical
replicates with error bars showing the s.d. Each graph is representative of n = 3
biological replicates performed under the same conditions.
